newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka stocks close at 28-month high on results.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka stocks close at 28-month high on results.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks broke through the psychological 850-point barrier on Wednesday to close at a 28-month high as investors bought shares in anticipation of more good interim results, brokers said.
The all share index closed 10.8 points up at 860.1 points. The index was last at these levels in early March, 1995.
Price gains outnumbered declines by 50 to 15. Blue chip John Keells Holdings rose 17.50 rupees to 390, Asia Capital 1.75 to 12.25, Lanka Tiles two to 20.
"It is like an infection," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.
"Since the few interim results released up to June have been exceptional, investors say those that are yet to come should also be good," he added.
Brokers said interim results released so far showed profit growth averaging about over 60 percent per company.
Turnover was 92.89 million rupees, led by local buying.
Foreign buying was worth 4.2 million rupees, while selling amounted to 26.7 million.

"Buying interest has risen significantly because some investors have also begun to take long-term positions," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena of Ceylinco Stock Brokers. "Since first half results have been good, they expect the second half to be even better." -- Prithi kodagoda (941) 434319
